description: A rectangular rug with a vibrant yellow base and a dark blue abstract line drawing. The design features a series of flowing, organic lines that intersect and overlap, creating a sense of movement and depth. Scattered throughout the pattern are small circular motifs, some with radiating lines resembling suns, and asterisk-like shapes. The overall aesthetic is modern and artistic, with a playful yet sophisticated feel. The texture of the rug appears to be woven, with a visible grain that adds to its tactile appeal.
